entities.name: FNDC3A (Q9Y2H6)
observations: The 768-aa query sequence matches reviewed human FNDC3A (UniProt Q9Y2H6) at 100% identity and 100% query coverage.
Reviewed UniProt annotation: mediates spermatid–Sertoli adhesion during spermatogenesis.
Annotated localization includes Golgi apparatus membrane; described as a single-pass membrane protein, with vesicular/acrosomal and cytoplasmic/cytosolic annotations.
Biological-process annotations include spermatid development; mouse ortholog annotations additionally include cell-cell adhesion, fertilization, and Sertoli-cell development.
Pfam scanning identified FNDC3_N at residues 34–99 and five fibronectin type III (fn3) domains at residues 274–361, 374–458, 475–557, 570–653, and 676–749.
Sequence-derived estimates: 768 aa, approximately 83.9 kDa; localization and functions are annotation evidence, not sequence-only predictions.
